title: Creamy Kani Gunkan
description: Nori boats filled with shredded crab stick, scallions, mayo and tobiko.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Check crab sticks are ready to eat according to their packaging. Shred and combine with Kewpie and thinly sliced scallions.
Shape 24 small rice ovals and cut nori strips tall enough to rise above the rice.
Wrap rice ovals in nori, sealing with a few rice grains.
Spoon kani filling into each gunkan and scatter optional tobiko over the top.
notes: Assemble just before eating so the nori remains textured.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
